name: Archnemesis
oracle_text:
Enchant opponent
Whenever you attack enchanted player, that player loses 2 life. You draw a card and gain 2 life.
Whenever a player attacks you, you may attach this Aura to that player.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a player attacks you, you may attach this Aura to that player.

needs.what: an effect that moves an Aura already on the battlefield onto a player (303.4, writing GameObject.attached_to_player via primitives.attach_to_player), with the host given as a player spec such as the attacking player from the trigger, optionally ('you may')
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `attach` op's `objects` is a selector over permanents and calls `primitives.attach` with an oid; nothing in `ops` re-attaches an Aura to a player. `attach_to_player` is only reached from `stack._attach_aura` when the Aura spell resolves with a player target, so a re-attach after it is on the battlefield cannot be said
